kjv: and said, Ye (James and John) know not what manner of spirit ye are of. For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.
mine: But he (Jesus) turned and rebuked them (James and John).
note: TR adds Jesus' words (9:55b-56a) with D and later manuscripts; absent from P45, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, A, C, L, W. The saying echoes Luke 19:10.

kjv: consume them (the Samaritans), even as Elias did?
note: TR adds "hos kai Elias epoiesen" (alluding to 2 Kgs 1:10-12); absent from P45, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L.

kjv: This is my beloved Son: hear him (Jesus)
mine: This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him (Jesus)!
note: TR "agapetos" ("beloved", from Mark/Matthew) against "eklelegmenos" ("chosen") in P45, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus, L (cf. Isa 42:1, Luke 23:35).

kjv: spake of his (Jesus') decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem
mine: spoke of his (Jesus') departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem
note: exodos is "departure" and evokes Israel's Exodus (death, resurrection and ascension as a new exodus); KJV's "decease" narrows it to death.
